description: A 'Product Concept Test 2025' survey has been run, but the data is contaminated with internal test submissions, spam, and incomplete responses. Your task is to clean the dataset in LimeSurvey. Log in (admin/Admin123!), navigate to the survey's Responses section, and permanently delete all records that meet ANY of these criteria: 1) Status is incomplete (no submit date), 2) First Name is 'TEST', or 3) Email ends with '@example.com'. You must PRESERVE all valid responses (e.g., real users like 'Jane Doe' or 'Marcus Smith'). Do not deactivate the survey.
